title: Normalized scalar tensor square under integral Hom presentation comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, finite coefficient fields E,L over Q_l, an embedding iota:E to L, and a scheme X. Let a,b be normalized IntegralHom tensor presentations over the two completed coefficient sheaves [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-models]. Let t identify integralOrdinaryScalar with completedOrdinaryScalarExtension, preserving every sheafified scalar tensor section s tensor x, and let e identify their derived functors and satisfy the cochain-counit equation of [lem-trf-integral-scalar-ordinary-model-comparison]. Write F for integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar, G for pbcDerivedExtend of completedCoefficientMap, SA,SB for scalarIntegralClosed, and mu for scalarClosedTensor [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension] transported from F to G by e. For any ambient K,N, let gamma_a(K) be Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq from a.adjunction K to SA.adjunction K, and gamma_b(GK) the corresponding target comparison. Then G.map(gamma_a(K).hom.app N) followed by mu.hom.app(N,K) equals the normalized scalarTensor(a,b).hom.app(K,N) followed by gamma_b(GK).hom.app(GN). This is a tensor square for arbitrary K,N, before taking an internal-Hom mate; it asserts no invertibility of a Hom comparison.

proof.text: Use tensorAdjointComparison_naturality to form the explicit natural tensor comparison between each supplied presentation and the canonical tensor in swapped order. Conjugate the canonical scalar tensor comparison transported by e with these two comparisons. This defines scalarTensorTransport without a choice of data.

scalarTensorTransport_normalization gives its defining scalar representative square on every flat-term K-flat pair. The uniqueness theorem for the normalized derived scalar tensor comparison identifies this natural isomorphism with PurCompactSupport.scalarTensor. At (K,N), postcompose the component equality with the target adjoint comparison; its inverse cancels. The remaining equation is exactly the original tensor square.

theorem scalarTensor_model_comparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) L] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[Padic l] L) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (a : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X))
    (b : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L X))
    (t : integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι X ≅
      completedOrdinaryScalarExtension.{u, u} l E L ι X)
    (e : integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l E L ι X ≅
      completedDerivedScalarExtension.{u, u} l E L ι X)
    (ht : ∀ (N : integralTowerModules l E X) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (s : (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L X).obj.obj U)
      (x : N.val.obj U),
      (t.hom.app N).val.app U (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι X N U s x) =
        completedScalarTensorSection.{u, u} l E L ι X N U s x)
    (he : ∀ P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E X) ℤ,
      e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫ completedScalarCounit.{u, u} l E L ι X P =
        (integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι X).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex t (.up ℤ)).hom.app P))
    (K N : IntegralVerdier.Ambient l E X) :
    (pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E L ι X)).map
        ((Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq (a.adjunction K)
          ((scalarIntegralClosed l E X).adjunction K)).hom.app N) ≫
      (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (scalarIntegralClosed l E X).tensor e.symm ≪≫
        scalarClosedTensor l E L ι X ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerRight (NatIso.prod e e) (scalarIntegralClosed l L X).tensor).hom.app
          (N, K) =
    (PurCompactSupport.scalarTensor (completedCoefficientMap l E L ι X)
        (tensorModel X a) (tensorModel X b)).hom.app (K, N) ≫
      (Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq
        (b.adjunction ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E L ι X)).obj K))
        ((scalarIntegralClosed l L X).adjunction
          ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E L ι X)).obj K))).hom.app
            ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E L ι X)).obj N)
